description: Get the documentation navigation: tabs, groups of pages, and pages with their paths. Call it without arguments to see every tab and its groups, then pass `tab` and `group_path` to see the pages of a group. A group marked "(not expanded)" in the markdown, or without pages and groups in the structured result, has pages or subgroups that the result leaves out.

depth.description: How many levels of groups below the start to include (default: 1). Groups at the last level come without their pages or subgroups; add their labels to `group_path` to see them. Each extra level makes the result larger.

format.description: Format of the text result (default: markdown). The structured result is always JSON.

group_path.description: Start at this group inside `tab`: the labels of the nested groups, outermost first (e.g., ["Context management"]). Needs `tab`.

tab.description: Start at this tab, by label or slug, including a sub-tab of a dropdown (e.g., messages, api-reference). Without it, the result covers every tab.

name: get_navigation

__schema1.description: A group without pages and groups has more that the depth input left out: add its label to group_path to see it.

title: List docs pages
